reviewer.name: Claude Sonnet, fresh subagent (the second cold reader)
reviewer.origin: Agent tool, a fresh context with only this brief and its files, launched by the Inner Child lane session (https://claude.ai/code/session_01NbUfhcTaRT8sbjyYV1wEFq), turn 115, 2026-10-26

evidence: Read “Stuff I wrote while I was scared can sound like a threat to them.” right after “Before sending anything, I’d read it once as if I were them, sitting there with my phone.”: “them” is the same recipient in both, the sentence still gives the reason (written scared, received as a threat), and the here/over-there balance is gone, leaving one plain statement; “sound” also fits the previous paragraph’s “how your voice sounds”. “while I was scared” keeps the approved paragraph’s own first-person claim (“when I wrote it”), so no new fact or promise, and “a threat to them” means the same whether read as perceived or as aimed at them. The last sentence is the reason, not a recap, so no closer, knock-down or not-X/it’s-Y is present. Linter: D9 is by design (same paragraph, one tell out, and the sentence still gives the reason for reading it as them).
